bugs.title: _supplierLink() excludes shop_logged token — Send link hidden for newly-flagged wrong-item rows
bugs.current_behaviour: A wrong-item dispute created via the sheet starts with status='shop_logged'. _supplierLink() only matches reminder_sent|accepted_missing|denied, so canonicalLink is empty and the Send link row is hidden.
bugs.why_wrong: Backend contract states all statuses carry a token. shop_logged is a valid pre-reminder state and the token is present. Admin must be able to send the link before or during the reminder.

bugs.title: _supplierCounts() counts cancelled disputes as unresolved — red badge inflated
bugs.current_behaviour: disputeStateOf() has no branch for 'cancelled'; it falls through to DisputeState.waiting (dispute_state.dart:15). A cancelled dispute is counted as unresolved, inflating the red badge.
bugs.why_wrong: Backend contract lists cancelled as a terminal status equivalent to resolved. _load() correctly excludes cancelled from openCount (line 6750) but _supplierCounts() does not mirror this.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Exclude cancelled from unresolved count — either add a cancelled arm to disputeStateOf() returning resolved, or check d['status'] != 'cancelled' explicitly.

bugs.title: _resolve() always passes p_outcome:'resolved', never agree_supplier or re_source for non-needsYou states
bugs.current_behaviour: For waiting, resourcing, and exchange states the Resolve button shows a plain confirm dialog and always calls fw_resolve_dispute with p_outcome='resolved'.
bugs.why_wrong: agree_supplier and re_source are distinct outcomes with downstream business meaning. An admin resolving a resourcing row almost certainly wants to record re_source, not generic resolved. The outcome is permanently mis-recorded.
bugs.correct_behaviour: The dialog should offer outcome options or default to a context-sensitive outcome (e.g. re_source for resourcing/exchange states).

bugs.title: GlobalKey sendKey created inside build() method — new key every rebuild — popover never opens
bugs.current_behaviour: Each setState call recreates the key. anchorKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject() always returns null. _DisputeContactPopover.show() hits the null guard at line 7326 and returns silently. The popover never opens.
bugs.why_wrong: GlobalKey instances must be stable — created once in State, not recreated in build().
bugs.correct_behaviour: Declare 'final GlobalKey _sendLinkKey = GlobalKey()' as a field on _DisputesScreenState and pass it to _buildOpenSupplierCard.

bugs.title: Header right-side cluster shifts width when red badge appears/disappears — not pixel-identical open vs closed
bugs.current_behaviour: When the red badge is hidden (allResolved), the cluster shrinks by 32px (28+4). The name Expanded reflows but the trailing cluster width is not pinned — the header visually jumps when transitioning between resolved and unresolved states.
bugs.why_wrong: Spec requires constant-position header pixel-identical open vs closed. Supplier Shop uses a fixed-width badge slot regardless of mode.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Reserve a fixed-width SizedBox(width:32) for the red badge slot even when hidden, so the cluster total width is always constant.

bugs.title: Send-link _onTap silently does nothing when _normalizeForWa returns empty — no feedback to admin
bugs.current_behaviour: If a contact value is a display name or email accidentally stored in the whatsapp[] array, _normalizeForWa strips all non-digits to '' and _onTap returns silently with no snackbar or feedback.
bugs.why_wrong: Silent failures on non-numeric contacts give admin zero indication something went wrong.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Show a snackbar ('No valid phone number for this contact') when intl.isEmpty instead of silently returning.

bugs.title: fulfill_item_sheet._deriveState() does not cover resolved or cancelled dispute status — shows re-action buttons on a closed dispute
bugs.current_behaviour: When existingDispute has status='resolved' or 'cancelled', _deriveState() does not match and falls through to switch(_localFsState). If the item is recorded as 'short', the sheet shows the Shortfall state with Reset/action buttons.
bugs.why_wrong: A resolved or cancelled dispute should show a read-only Resolved banner, not action buttons that imply the dispute can be re-opened.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Add 'resolved' and 'cancelled' to the disputeActive guard, or add a dedicated disputeResolved state that renders a read-only resolved banner.

bugs.title: supplier_disputes_screen canRespond only accepts reminder_sent — supplier cannot respond when status is shop_logged
bugs.current_behaviour: The public dispute form page accepts reminder_sent OR shop_logged. The supplier authed portal only accepts reminder_sent. A wrong-item dispute created via the sheet (status shop_logged) shows disabled buttons in the supplier portal.
bugs.why_wrong: The two surfaces are inconsistent. Backend supplier_respond_dispute is callable when status is shop_logged. Supplier portal silently blocks a valid action.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Match the public page: canRespond = status == 'reminder_sent' || status == 'shop_logged'.

bugs.title: Send-link popover has no Copy link fallback — dead-end when supplier has no contacts
bugs.field_rpc_arg: if (!hasAny) → 'No contacts saved for this supplier.' (no further action)
bugs.current_behaviour: When all four contact lists (whatsapp, contact, phone, other) are empty, the popover shows 'No contacts saved' with no further action. The canonical link is available but not accessible.
bugs.why_wrong: Admin has no way to share the link without dismissing and finding another method. The link is already passed into the popover.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Add a 'Copy link' button to the empty-state footer that copies widget.link to clipboard.

bugs.title: _DisputesScreenState._load() catch block is silent — network failure shows false 'No open disputes' success state
bugs.current_behaviour: If fw_get_disputes throws (network outage, auth expiry), _disputes stays [], _loading becomes false, and build() renders the empty-state success view with a checkmark and 'No open disputes.'
bugs.why_wrong: Admin sees a false-positive success state during an outage. There is no indication of an error and no meaningful retry path.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Add an _error field; when caught, show an error banner with a Retry button rather than the empty-state success view.

bugs.title: Tab badge deduplicates by order_item_id; inner list counts raw rows — counts diverge when one item has multiple disputes
bugs.field_rpc_arg: tab: map.length (keyed by order_item_id) vs inner: raw.where(isOpen).length
bugs.current_behaviour: The render-log hardcodes 'inner_open_count=$openCount;equal=true' but the two counts use different deduplication logic and will diverge when one order_item_id has multiple active disputes.
bugs.why_wrong: Tab badge shows e.g. '4' but inner list shows 7 cards — confusing to the admin.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Both counts should use the same predicate (raw row count by status, not deduped by order_item_id).

bugs.title: Wrong-item admin card shows product name in 'Ordered' field instead of ordered quantity
bugs.field_rpc_arg: _kvRow('Ordered', product) — product is the product NAME string
bugs.current_behaviour: The admin item card for wrong_item kind shows: Ordered | Metformin 500mg (product name, not qty). The 'Ordered' label implies a quantity.
bugs.why_wrong: Misleading label — looks like a data bug to the admin reviewing disputes.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Change label to 'Ordered item' (or 'Expected') and 'Sent instead', and optionally add a separate _kvRow('Qty ordered', '$ordered').

bugs.title: No way to hide resolved items inside an open supplier dropdown — resolved rows crowd the list
bugs.current_behaviour: Resolved items are silently rendered in the item list with no action buttons. fw_get_disputes returns both open and resolved rows. There is no filter chip or toggle to hide resolved rows (removed in #170 without replacement). A supplier with 1 open + 4 resolved items shows 5 full cards.
bugs.why_wrong: Admin must scroll through resolved noise to reach the actionable item. UX clutter with no way to dismiss.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Add a per-supplier 'Show resolved (N)' toggle at the bottom of the item list, or auto-collapse resolved items.

bugs.title: _DisputeContactPopover._entry is static and never cleared on widget dispose — orphaned overlay persists after tab switch
bugs.current_behaviour: If the user navigates away from the Disputes tab while the popover is open, _entry is not cleared. No dispose() on _DisputesScreenState removes it. The orphaned overlay entry persists over the new tab's content.
bugs.why_wrong: Overlay entries must be removed on widget disposal or route change. The popover can cover unrelated UI after tab switch.
bugs.correct_behaviour: Override dispose() on _DisputesScreenState to call: _DisputeContactPopover._entry?.remove(); _DisputeContactPopover._entry = null;
